name: Spouse DOB Validation — Underage Spouse
goal: User enters a spouse DOB indicating age under 18; bot enforces age validation and re-prompts.
constraints: Spouse DOB entered makes spouse only 16 years old.

result.message: You are eligible to book an appointment.

phases.description: Bot presents booking option; user chooses to book.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays eligibility message and quick reply for booking; user selects 'Book an appointment'.

phases.description: Bot asks for coverage type; user selects 'Only Spouse'.
User enters underage DOB for spouse.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects input, displays age error, and re-prompts.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
